limits: One arm of a paired same-session capture (paired-same-session-v2): the controlled Training Range workload of the frozen V2 candidate capture, with the archived sampler unchanged, 214 measured frames per profile, software rendering. An arm report alone decides nothing: the session report holds validity and the rules, and the registry verdict holds the result. No input, network or whole-game frame rate, no device certification and no human motion acceptance.

comparison.reason: Actual source-eye essential view differs from external baseline camera/workload

componentDefinitions.frameIntervalMs: native RAF interval through completed rendering; PNG encoding excluded
